source_text: A 2017 systematic review and meta-analysis of 27 studies involving 1,498,536 males reported an overall meatal stenosis risk of 0.656% (95% CI: 0.089–1.218%) in circumcised individuals, which was not statistically significantly different from the 0.92% (95% CI: 0.11–1.74%) observed in uncircumcised controls.
